explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/591: is ω^{ω²} → (ω^{ω²}, 3)²? Proved by Schipperus and Darby. OrdinalCardinalRamsey α β c says every red/blue (IsCompl) colouring of the complete graph on α.ToType has a red clique of order type β or a blue clique of cardinality c. `ω ^ ω ^ 2` parses right-associatively as ω^(ω²). The statement is exactly the partition relation. Faithful.
